subject: english
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blanks with the correct homophone.**

His eyes ______ up with fascination when he saw his idol standing in front of him.
solution: The correct answer is **"lit."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Homophones are words that sound the same but have different meanings. • **"Lit" **means illuminated or on fire. (प्रकाशित या आग पर) • **Example**: *There is a **lit**__ window at dusk.* • In this sentence, the correct homophone to use is **"lit" **since it implies a sense of awe or excitement. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *His eyes __**lit**__ up with fascination when he saw his idol standing in front of him. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Lye**: a strong alkaline solution used for cleaning or making soap. (सफाई या साबुन बनाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला एक मजबूत क्षारीय घोल) • **Lite**: a variation of "light" meaning low in calories or weight. ("प्रकाश" का एक प्रकार जिसका अर्थ है कम कैलोरी या वजन) • **Life**: refers to the existence of living beings. (जीवित प्राणियों के अस्तित्व को संदर्भित करता है) 3c:T6bc, The correct answer is** "Beyond a doubt."**
